subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error mark 'No error' as your answer.

The aeroplane took down / without the passengers after / making a sudden announcement.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "took down" is incorrect in this context.
 
• The correct phrase should be "took off," which means the aeroplane left the ground and started flying.
 
• Thus, the error is in **Option 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The aeroplane took off without the passengers after making a sudden announcement."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **2: "without the passengers after"** – This part of the sentence is correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **3: "making a sudden announcement"** – This part of the sentence is correct and does not require any changes.
